nodes.title: Prepare H3 Generation
widgets_values: Regenerate only the white mask region while preserving the source scene and synchronized audio.

Normal inpaint: keep control_video_resource_id and Pose preprocessor fields empty. The white mask region is regenerated; source_video remains the preservation source. The connected Pose branch is lazy and is not requested in this state.

Optional Pose: set MMH3 Control Configure → control_video_resource_id to a control/video resource whose extensions.minimax_h3.control.control_kind is pose. If provenance is recorded, use preprocessor_name=external_pose and its exact version. The same H3 Fun Union checkpoint is used for inpaint; Pose adds a structural control stream and does not replace the mask/source-video contract.

H3 Sampling owns the acceleration adapter and records the actual LoRA hash. Select Standard - 20 steps for stock sampling. H3 Fun Control uses the upstream MODEL_PATCH contract (#15975); put the checkpoint in models/model_patches (preferred) or models/controlnet.
